name: @curator/swapvm-program-builder
description: Lane D — SwapVM strategy program builder, compiled against 1inch's official libraries
comment: Solidity dependencies arrive through npm, not forge submodules, because that
is how 1inch ship swap-vm and aqua (their remappings.txt points at
node_modules/). It also avoids writing to the repo-root .gitmodules, which
Lane A's Foundry project would be writing to at the same time.
swap-vm is PINNED TO v1.0.1 because that is what is actually deployed on
branch was silently wrong: main renumbered the entire instruction set from
positional array indices into a banked hex enum (XYCSwap 18 -> 0x50), so a
program compiled against main encodes instructions the deployed contract
cannot execute. Verified by selector: the deployed contract exposes
swap(Order,uint256,bytes). Do not unpin without re-checking the deployment.
